race.comment: Some promising types come together. Settled on GAULTIER (1) who returned from a 15-month absence with an encouraging second last start over 1300m at Hawkesbury where he was strong through the line. Has a tricky gate to deal with but if things go right he can take this out. BARR TURN (3) started at big odds but ran a cheeky race on debut last time out over 1300m at Kembla, battling on well for third after leading for the judge. Strong contender with some natural improvement to come. ENDEAVOUR (5) raced at the back of a small field then went home nicely on debut recently over 1200m at Canterbury. Big chance on a roomier track over a bit more ground today. CAVIAR (2) returned from a 14-month lay-off with a decent third over 1200m at Gosford 16 days ago. Bred to want further than that so this race looks a nice fit. CONCRETE STORM (8) has been kept fresh since a pleasing return at Wyong a month ago. Should be thereabouts again.
